name: Mahito
content:
Mahito is one of the primary antagonists of the Jujutsu Kaisen series.
He is an unregistered special grade cursed spirit allied with Pseudo-Geto.
He is also the leader of his own group, consisting of Jogo, Hanami, and Dagon.
His group's ultimate goal is the eradication of humanity and ultimately replacing the population with cursed spirits.
